title: This Man Secretly Saved 669 Children From the Nazis
description:
Nicholas Winton, a British stockbroker, secretly organized trains that rescued 669 mostly Jewish children from Czechoslovakia before WWII. Almost nobody knew for 50 years.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
